## Goal
- Complete IVX IA’s end-to-end release: prevent stale mutation proof, publish the public-chat HTTP `200` blocker fix, provision/verify execution infrastructure, and obtain truthful live acceptance evidence.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do not use or request the legacy static owner token.
- Preserve Supabase JWT owner authorization; do not weaken direct-owner controls.
- Keep server-to-server worker authorization HMAC-based, expiring, single-use, and exact action/SHA bound.
- Never print, commit, or expose credential values.
- Public-chat policy blocks must be renderable HTTP `200` completed turns; authorization failures remain `401`/`403`; `409` only represents real state conflicts.
- Do not claim release completion without GitHub, Render, health/version, and live endpoint evidence.
- Exclude unrelated `.rork/history/main/*.json` and `ios-ivx-holdings/` changes from the backend release.

## Progress
### Done
- Audited current deployed production:
  - Render API service: `ivx-holdings-platform`, `srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0`, `web_service`, branch `main`, `autoDeploy:"yes"`.
  - Render active deployment: `dep-d9hu14kfnr2s73anrtj0`, `live`, commit `934e7e5eb7436d0a56b9b1974abf0a870110f848`.
  - GitHub `main` is `934e7e5eb7436d0a56b9b1974abf0a870110f848`, message `release: publish validated IVX iOS source`.
  - Production health/version previously matched SHA `934e7e5eb7436d0a56b9b1974abf0a870110f848`.
  - Chat frontend `https://chat.ivxholding.com/` returned HTTP `200`.
  - Unauthenticated `/api/ivx/senior-developer/worker/status` correctly returned HTTP `401` with marker `ivx-senior-developer-worker-2026-07-17`.
- Confirmed Render currently exposes only:
  - `ivx-holdings-chat-frontend`, `srv-d7t9j00sfn5c738a18j0`, `static_site`.
  - `ivx-holdings-platform`, `srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0`, `web_service`.
  - No actual background worker service named `ivx-senior-dev-01`.
- Confirmed `render.yaml` declares a missing dedicated worker:
  - `type: worker`
  - `name: ivx-senior-dev-01`
  - entry command `node /app/node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs /app/backend/workers/ivx-senior-dev-worker-entry.ts`
  - requires private Supabase, GitHub, Render, AI gateway, `IVX_INTERNAL_DEPLOY_SECRET`, and `IVX_INTERNAL_WORKER_ID` configuration.
- Inspected current API Render environment variable names only; values remained secret. It includes `IVX_SENIOR_DEV_WORKER_ENABLED`, `GITHUB_TOKEN`, `IVX_FORCE_DEPLOY_SHA`, `IVX_FORCE_REDEPLOY`, owner settings, and AI/Supabase configuration.
- Local public-chat fix and signed deployment authorization implementation remain present and previously focused-tested.
- Existing stale proof defect remains documented:
  - Job `ivx-worker-639a1564-5ea8-4f2c-8000-2997728b338a` reused commit `934e7e5eb7436d0a56b9b1974abf0a870110f848` and deployment `dep-d9hu14kfnr2s73anrtj0`.
  - It was incorrectly executed as `QA_ONLY`, produced no changed files, yet presented completion-like evidence.

  - Local `HEAD`: `28027c14` — `System review and status update on the chat improvement.`
  - GitHub request for `28027c14` returned HTTP `422`: `No commit found for SHA: 28027c14`.
  - Local `origin` is a Rork-managed router URL, not the GitHub repository URL.

  - `expo/sync-github.mjs` uses GitHub’s Git Tree API.
  - It requires `GITHUB_TOKEN` and `GITHUB_REPO` or `GITHUB_REPO_URL`.

### In Progress
- Repair and complete stale-proof rejection in `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts`.
- Repair the newly modified regression test import and make the focused test suite pass again.
- Isolate release-only backend changes from `.rork/history/main/00mrzo37s7000_oibrh0lb3m1t2pyaap1mn_assistant.json`.
- Publish the actual reviewed local revision to `ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest` `main`.
- Provision or otherwise establish the required Render background worker and bind private credentials without exposing them.

### Blocked
- Production still runs old GitHub/Render SHA `934e7e5eb7436d0a56b9b1974abf0a870110f848`; local `28027c14` is not on GitHub.
- Live `POST https://api.ivxholding.com/api/public/chat` with `{"message":"deploy now"}` still returns HTTP `409` with marker `ivx-pre-execution-feasibility-gate-2026-07-05-v1`, not required HTTP `200` with visible `answer`.
- Dedicated worker is declared in `render.yaml` but absent from the actual Render account.
- The most recent local focused-test run is failing because `backend/api/ivx-senior-developer-worker.test.ts` imports a non-exported symbol from the wrong module:
  - `SyntaxError: Export named 'summarizeAutonomousCoderProof' not found in module '/home/user/rork-app/backend/api/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts'.`
- Attempted stale-proof implementation edit did not apply:
  - `functions.multiEdit` failed with: `Old string ... found multiple times in file backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts. Please add more context around or allow to replaceAll.`
  - Therefore `summarizeAutonomousCoderProof()` still showed its old behavior at lines 753–766: it marks `proof.finalStatus === 'COMPLETED'` as `ok` without validating changed-file/new-SHA/deploy proof.
- Full typecheck remains blocked by unrelated existing errors:
  - `backend/api/ivx-investor-performance.ts(82,39): error TS2339: Property 'totalDistributions' does not exist on type 'AccountSummary'.`
  - `backend/api/ivx-investor-performance.ts(114,23): error TS2339: Property 'id' does not exist on type 'LedgerEntry'.`
  - `backend/api/ivx-owner-ai.ts(7712,9): error TS2322: Type '"ivx_qa_only_runtime"' is not assignable...`
  - `backend/hono.ts(5059,28): error TS2554: Expected 2 arguments, but got 1.`

## Key Decisions
- Require mutation proof to show changed files, a fresh commit distinct from `startingSha`, and for deploy jobs a new deployment plus `liveCommit === commitSha`; otherwise result must be failed/non-production-complete.
- Do not accept health/version parity with an old SHA as proof of a requested source fix.
- Keep owner-approved mutation execution-mode precedence:
  - `approveGitDeploy:true` → `deploy`.
  - `approvePatch:true` without deploy approval → `code_change`.
  - Explicit `qa_only` cannot downgrade an owner-approved mutation.
- Fix the regression test by importing `summarizeAutonomousCoderProof` from `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts`, not `backend/api/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts`.
- Do not use the local Rork `origin` as evidence of GitHub publication; use the configured GitHub API/tree publishing path and then independently verify GitHub `main`.

1. Correct `backend/api/ivx-senior-developer-worker.test.ts` imports:
   - keep `resolveWorkerExecutionMode` from `./ivx-senior-developer-worker`;
   - import `summarizeAutonomousCoderProof` from `../services/ivx-senior-developer-worker`.
2. Apply a narrowly targeted edit to `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts`:
   - add stale/no-change mutation proof validation before `summarizeAutonomousCoderProof()` returns success;
   - reject no `filesChanged`, no `commitSha`, `commitSha === startingSha`, missing `deployId`, and unverified/mismatched live deploy proof.
3. Run:
   - `bun test backend/api/ivx-senior-developer-worker.test.ts backend/services/ivx-completion-validator.test.ts backend/services/ivx-public-chat-gate-response.test.ts backend/services/ivx-pre-execution-feasibility-gate.test.ts backend/services/ivx-internal-deploy-auth.test.ts`
   - `git diff --check`
4. Review `git status --short`; exclude `.rork/history/main/00mrzo37s7000_oibrh0lb3m1t2pyaap1mn_assistant.json` and unrelated work.
5. Use `expo/sync-github.mjs` with the configured GitHub repository/token environment to publish only the reviewed release files to `ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest` `main`.
6. Verify the resulting GitHub commit through `https://api.github.com/repos/ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest/commits/main`.
7. Trigger/poll Render `srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0` until a new deployment is `live` on that exact GitHub SHA.
8. Verify `/health` and `/version` report the new SHA.
9. Verify `POST https://api.ivxholding.com/api/public/chat` with `{"message":"deploy now"}` returns HTTP `200`, `ok:true`, and non-empty visible `answer`.
10. Create/provision `ivx-senior-dev-01` as a Render `background_worker` if it is required for production queue execution; configure required private environment variables and verify it runs without revealing values.
11. Record the exact fresh SHA, Render deployment ID, worker identity/status, focused-test results, and public-chat acceptance output in `.rork/plans/force-sync-ivx-workspace-and-release-eve_1784928084433.plan.md`.
